{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders and refunded orders
total_rows = len(df)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Convert revenue to float after cleaning
# First, remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Now, remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of valid age rows
valid_age_rows = len(df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1])

# Calculate mean age, excluding -1
mean_age = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')
print(f'Valid age rows (customer_age != -1): {valid_age_rows}')
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age}')"}
